plain_english: If you ever find yourself focusing on external things just to please someone else, know that you've wrecked your whole approach to life. Be satisfied with simply being a philosopher in everything you do. And if you want to appear philosophical to others, just appear that way to yourself. That's enough.
original_excerpt: If you ever happen to turn your attention to externals, for the pleasure of anyone, be assured that you have ruined your scheme of life. Be content, then, in everything, with being a philosopher; and if you wish to seem so likewise to anyone, appear so to yourself, and it will suffice you.
